_doc: The Referral Connection site agent: one job-running agent for findreferralpartners.com, added to a Grok bot that already exists or run as its own bot. Each routine hands one job (jobs/<job>.md) to the Claude Code CLI through tools/job.py. tools/team.py, tools/install.py and tools/check.py read this.
name: the Referral Connection site agent

agents.does: Everything about the referral site: sign-ups, listings, matches and introductions; filling the launch area; guides and the site check; the nightly numbers
routines: First save today's new posts from any signed-in Skool or Whop community in /workspace/referral-connection/context/communities.md to /workspace/referral-connection/data/communities/<date>/<name>.txt with your browser. Then run python3 /workspace/referral-connection/repo/tools/job.py run referral-growth
Run python3 /workspace/referral-connection/repo/tools/job.py run referral-report. Then post /workspace/referral-connection/daily/<date>/report.md, as it is, to Slack and to the Notion hub
